 At Network International, we always stay ahead. . In the fast\-paced world of financial services, we thrive on innovation, agility, and purposeful collaboration. We invest first in our people, empowering you to make bold decisions, learn fast, and grow your expertise alongside industry leaders. Here, solving complex problems means more than using cutting\-edge technology; it’s about creating meaningful value for our customers, together.  •Understanding of payment operations (acquiring, issuing, settlement) and associated regulatory/scheme environments
 



 •Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent process improvement frameworks; Green Belt certification a plus
 



 •Exposure to automation/RPA concepts and ability to identify process candidates for technology‑enabled solutions
 



**Key Competencies** 




 •Analytical thinking with strong problem‑solving and root‑cause analysis skills
 



 •Excellent visual communication and ability to translate complex processes into clear, actionable designs
 



 •Collaborative and comfortable facilitating cross‑functional workshops with Operations, Technology, and Risk teams
 



 •Customer‑centric mindset with empathy for merchant, partner, and cardholder experiences

**Job Description**
 The Director of Marketing Strategy and Operations will lead the development of forward\-looking marketing strategies and growth narratives in support of our 2030 milestones.
   

  

 Based in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, this leader will drive revenue enablement and profitability for Visa and their partners, and establish vital operational rigor across our regional clusters. This role is a critical business partner and growth catalyst embedded directly within the Marketing Services business unit.
   

  

 Working horizontally across Business Development, Visa Consulting and Analytics, Product, and regional/global teams, the Director will scale the proprietary frameworks, tools, and processes that empower Visa to capture emerging affluent wealth segments, drive local commerce trends, and commercialize next\-generation marketing innovations (including AI\-driven and Generative Engine Optimization models).
   

  

 The position reports directly to the Senior Director for Marketing Services GCC
   

  

 The Strategy, Planning, and Operations team serves as the ultimate connective tissue for the department, partnering with marketing leadership to:
   

  

* Design and manage a cohesive operating plan that protects fiscal integrity and supports strategic objectives for Visa and their partners.
* Formulate high\-impact commercial narratives for top\-tier clients and financial institutions.
* Address complex regulatory, compliance, and controllership procedures across the GCC, with a primary focus on the rapidly expanding Saudi market.


**Essential Functions**

**About The Role**
 The Art Director is a senior creative delivery role within M\+C Saatchi Sport \& Entertainment Middle East, responsible for leading the visual and conceptual development of sport and events campaigns across the agency's client portfolio.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Client Director, the Art Director will take briefs from strategy and account teams and translate them into compelling creative territories, campaign identities, event experiences, and activation assets that perform across all channels and touchpoints.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, high\-output role suited to a creative who understands the energy, pace, and visual language of sport and live events. You will be expected to concept and create at speed, uphold quality standards across a busy client roster, and contribute to the creative direction of the agency's most visible and complex campaigns.
   

  

 The Art Director will play an important role in shaping the agency's creative output \- working across event branding, sponsorship activations, fan engagement, social content and pitch development \- while supporting and developing the wider creative team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Campaign Creative \& Concept Development**
* Lead creative development from brief to delivery across sports and events campaigns, ensuring all work is on\-brief, on\-brand, and commercially sound.
* Translate strategic briefs into visual creative territories, mood boards, campaign frameworks and creative rationales.
* Develop and present multiple creative routes with clarity and confidence, both internally and in client\-facing settings.
* Oversee creative quality and visual consistency across all client touchpoints and across the full campaign lifecycle.


**Sports \& Events Creative**
* Design and develop event identity systems, environmental branding, wayfinding, fan zone concepts and large\-format experiential assets.
* Create campaign visual assets for major sporting events, sponsor activations, athlete partnerships and fan engagement activations.
* Produce creative across OOH, digital, social, print, broadcast and environmental formats as required by client campaigns.
* Stay ahead of design and visual communication trends in global sports marketing, live events and fan culture.


**Client \& Agency Presentations**
* Support the development of new business pitch decks, credentials presentations and agency marketing materials.
* Present creative work to clients with confidence, manage feedback clearly and see revisions through to final artwork.
* Help the agency bring creative ambition to pitches and proposals, positioning M\+C Saatchi S\&E ME as a best\-in\-class creative partner.


**Creative Team \& Production**
* Brief, direct and review work from freelance designers, illustrators, photographers and video producers.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining quality and meeting deadlines without compromising standards.
* Oversee artwork trafficking and file management, ensuring all assets are delivered to specification for print and digital use.
* Manage relationships with print suppliers, production studios and external creative partners where required.
* Support and mentor junior members of the creative team, helping to build capability and a culture of high standards.


**Cross\-Department Collaboration**
* Work closely across all departments to deliver integrated creative solutions.
* Collaborate with the Social Media team to ensure campaign creative works effectively across all social platforms.
* Contribute to internal creative reviews and help raise the quality of creative output across all agency accounts.


 ABOUT YOU
   

  

**Essential**
* 5\+ years of experience as an Art Director, Senior Designer or equivalent creative role, with a strong portfolio demonstrating sport and/or events work.
* Exceptional design craft with a sharp eye for typography, layout, colour and visual storytelling.
* Proven experience across multiple formats: campaign identities, event branding, social content, large\-format production and presentation design.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite: Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign.
* Strong conceptual thinking \- able to generate original ideas and develop them from sketch to final delivery.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced agency environment managing multiple client briefs simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills \- confident in client\-facing situations.
* Understanding of the GCC and Middle East market, cultural sensitivities and visual communication norms.


**Desirable**
* Proven experience on major sporting events \- rugby, football, motorsport, tennis, athletics or equivalent.
* Motion graphics and video editing skills: After Effects, Premiere Pro.
* Experience working with government entities, tourism boards, rights holders or sports federations in the region.
* Bilingual creative capability in English and Arabic.


**What Great Looks Like**
 Success in this role means producing creative that is confident, original and purposeful \- work that wins pitches, elevates client campaigns and makes the agency proud.
   

  

 You are the person who brings energy and clarity to a brief. You concept quickly, execute with precision, and know how to read a room when presenting. You understand the difference between a great idea and a great execution \- and you deliver both.
   

  

 You work well with strategy and account teams without needing to be spoon\-fed. You push back constructively when a brief is not right, and you take responsibility for quality at every stage of the process.
   

  

 You are as comfortable art directing an event identity system for a major sports property as you are turning around a social asset for a sponsor activation at pace. You understand sport, you understand the region, and you bring both to your work.
   

  

 Ready to lead. Built for sport and entertainment industry. Focused on quality, originality and delivery.
   

  

 This role is suited to a strong, confident Art Director who wants to be at the centre of one of the region's most exciting creative agency environments.
   

  

**Applications close on Friday, June 26, 2026\.**
**About Our Local Office**
 We were born out of the need for strategic and brutally effective creativity in the region. With every successful campaign, we have grown, and cherry\-picked the best professionals to work with us from all over the region and the world. In 2012, we opened our Abu Dhabi office and expanded our team with our Dubai office in 2016 and then our Riyadh office in 2023\. From these offices we manage a number of local and global brands across the Middle East and Europe. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is the creative philosophy of M\+C Saatchi. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is therefore a painful necessity.

 M\+C Saatchi Group is a creative federation of companies who navigate, create, and lead meaningful change for clients across five specialist divisions connected through people, culture, data, technology and creativity, M\+C Saatchi Group aims to unlock new value for clients and leave a positive impact on the world. M\+C Saatchi Group’s work is informed by two core principles \- Brutal Simplicity of Thought and Diversity of Thought. Together they guide how problems are solved and integrated specialist teams are built. Headquartered in London, M\+C Saatchi Group have circa 2,500 employees globally. Our global operations span 23 countries with major hubs in the UK, Europe, Middle East \& Africa, Asia and Australia.

 At M\+C Saatchi Group, our ambition is to create and curate Cultural Power for our clients. We do this by connecting specialist expertise, powered by creativity, data and technology, to help build famous brands and solve the most complex business and societal challenges.

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Responsible for managing the portfolio of Group\-wide strategy assignments (domestic \& international)
* Develop metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs) for performance measurement and monitoring purposes related to assigned strategy and implementation projects on a periodic basis
* Own and lead the development as well as review of the financial plan for strategy assignments
* Assist the SEVP and EVP in identifying, analyzing and monitoring issues that impact or could affect the profitability, growth and productivity of the organization (domestic \& international).
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for Senior Vice President, Strategy Development.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Own, lead and manage the portfolio of Group\-wide strategy assignments such as full scale regional strategies, individual country strategies (for all applicable lines of business) or business unit strategy development
* Ensure the integration of internal and external customer needs and requirements within the strategy assignments and implementation projects
* Lead the interactions with senior internal customers from business divisions, support divisions or country GMs for strategy assignments and implementation projects to ensure smooth management and alignment of deliverables
* Act as a reliable competent contact partner to all business, support divisions as well as country GMs within the delivery of strategy assignments and implementation projects
* Manage other Group Strategy\-related activities and mandates, such as supporting yearly business planning, performance management, development of strategic plans across QNB Group, GCEO interviews, Board presentations and preparation of other public documents as requested
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Obtain mandates, input and project brief on dedicated strategy assignment and implementation projects from SEVP and EVP
* Align scope, direction and deliverables of strategy assignments and implementation projects with EVP Strategy \& Business Development
* Lead multiple strategy projects simultaneously and supervise all project phases
* Develop and prepare set up of specific strategy assignments or implementation projects in terms of content, scope, structure, deliverables, timing, resources and work plans
* Manage project teams on a day\-to\-day basis to provide guidance, direction and supervision to the project teams to ensure timely high quality and impact delivery
* Guide the Vice Principal
* Strategy Development in the development of hypothesis formulation, analyses, market sizing and baselining exercises, formulation of frameworks and strategic recommendations as well as conclusions
* Review, discuss and align project deliverables with the project teams
* Assist the EVP Strategy \& Business Development in reviewing and providing feedback on the performance of the project team, as well as the section’s overall performance on a regular basis and making recommendations as necessary
* Supervise the Strategy Development team as established by the Group. These tasks include participating in the management of all HR issues related to the team such as: team performance, absence management, training needs identification and other requests
* Constantly endeavor to implement industry best practice standards within the development of strategic recommendations and governance frameworks.
* Bring in significant leadership to the division/department, ensuring that effective controls and resources are available to manage and control work volumes.
* Manage recruitment, provide motivation, guidance to employees and reinforce high standards concerning performance, and adherence to the Bank’s values and mission.
* Manage strong/effective relationships with related departments/units to achieve the Group’s objectives


**Continuous Improvement**
* Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes.
* Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard.
* Continuously encourage and recognise the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team.
* Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Identify any areas for professional development of self and all direct reports, and act to enhance professional development of self and others
* Ensure the provision of relevant guidance, direction and training to subordinates to develop and enhance their skills
* Assess performance of direct reports and provide regular feedback on their development (including recognizing strengths and providing challenges)
* Demonstrate ability to provide the team with support, direction and vision, including motivating people to perform, listening to people
* Maintain a high level of knowledge about banking processes, regulations, and generally accepted operating practices. Research industry topics and react by recommending changes to products, services, and systems \- Possess a superior knowledge of strategy and business development techniques/ tools and methodologies including various strategic frameworks, concepts and practices
* Complete all mandatory training or seminars provided by the Bank, in order to attain and maintain the required levels of competence
* Carry out other similar duties that can be defined within the broad functional job and functional responsibilities outlined above. These may include providing all necessary training to the department staff and handling special missions assigned by the management
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities:
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role. \- Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.


**Education/Experience Requirements**
* Bachelors / Masters (Masters preferred) and MBA from leading academic institution
* Minimum 15 years work experience with a demonstrable track record of at least 7 years in a strategy development role and most recently as a Senior Manager, either from top\-tier strategy consulting firms such as McKinsey \& Co, BCG, Bain \& Co, Booz \& Co, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger etc. or from a similar environment of a well\-renowned international financial services institution
* Demonstrated career development and progress, together with excellent team leadership skills and potential
* Proven track record and substantial management experience in managing and leading strategy assignments from concept to implementation
* High degree of analytical and methodological\-conceptual skills


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Passport
* Educational Certificates
